name: MODS Shortcut
author: hleawilliams-commits
summary: Hide the WAVEFORM heading and use MODS to open SOURCE for the official Mod Menu.
description: SDK-only community mod. MODS opens SOURCE; select MOD MENU to open the official menu. 0.1.3 registers spare input lanes and moves to the next when the core switches one off, dims the button with a SOURCE > MOD MENU message when none remain, and logs each tap's outcome. Physical navigation and LOAD cancel the shortcut. Hide WAVEFORM heading blanks only its title area; touches pass through. Official core timing protections are unchanged. No track loading, audio or library writes.
